43: # Terminal capability helpers live here to preserve the existing
44: # ``conda.common.io`` import path. If a dedicated terminal module is introduced,
45: # keep these functions re-exported here until callers can migrate.
46: def is_tty() -> bool:
47:     """Return True if both stdin and stdout are connected to a TTY."""
48:     return (
49:         hasattr(sys.stdout, "isatty")
50:         and sys.stdout.isatty()
51:         and hasattr(sys.stdin, "isatty")
52:         and sys.stdin.isatty()
53:     )
54: 
55: 
56: def term_dumb() -> bool:
57:     """
58:     Return True when the terminal is known to be incapable of ANSI escape codes.
59: 
60:     ``TERM=dumb`` (and ``TERM=unknown``) signals that the terminal cannot
61:     handle *any* escape sequences — not just colour.  This suppresses all
62:     animations (spinners, progress bars) as well as colour output.
63:     """
64:     return os.environ.get("TERM") in ("dumb", "unknown")
65: 
66: 
67: def no_color() -> bool:
68:     """
69:     Return True when *color* output should be suppressed.
70: 
71:     Respects the ``NO_COLOR`` standard (https://no-color.org/): color is
72:     suppressed when the ``NO_COLOR`` environment variable is set to any value.
73:     Non-color ANSI formatting (bold, underline, etc.) may still be used.
